name: Numa
description: Ad-blocking DNS resolver with DNSSEC-validating recursive resolution, DoH/DoT/Oblivious DoH, ephemeral overrides, and local service domains, in a single Rust binary (alternative to Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, NextDNS). ([Source Code](https://github.com/razvandimescu/numa)) `MIT` `Rust/Docker/Nix`
